title: SetShipControlCommand
description: The complete control intent of one tick for the ship this session's actor is flying: where the pilot wants to be pointing, how hard the thrusters are pushed, and which two assists are engaged. THE CLIENT CANNOT SEND A POSITION, A VELOCITY OR ITS CURRENT ATTITUDE: those words are not in this vocabulary, so a client that tries to place its ship is rejected by the schema and by serde, not merely ignored (CLAUDE.md principle 1, I-26). aim_* is the attitude the pilot WANTS - an intent about the future, not a claim about the present - and the server decides how fast the ship may turn toward it, which is why it does not weaken server authority. Every field is absolute state, not a delta, so a lost or superseded input is harmless: the server carries the previous input forward (ADR-0011 section 4). 좌표계 규약 (ADR-0009 section 1): 왼손 좌표계, Y-up. +X = 함선 기준 오른쪽, +Y = 위, +Z = 전방(뱃머리). 쿼터니언은 (x,y,z,w) 순서의 Hamilton 곱. 이 문장이 축 의미의 정본이며 구현은 여기서만 읽는다.

input_seq.description: This session's input counter. The server echoes the newest consumed value in WORLD_SNAPSHOT.ack_input_seq so the client can replay its unacknowledged inputs.

thrust_z_milli.description: Ship-local +Z (forward) thrust intent. Positive uses the main engine, negative the weaker reverse thrusters.

roll_milli.description: Manual roll rate intent about the ship-local +Z axis. A non-zero value suspends auto-levelling for this tick.

aim_x_micro.description: Target attitude quaternion x. The server renormalises and turns toward it at the ship class turn rate; it never adopts it directly.

brake.description: Held brake. While true, thrust is ignored and velocity is bled at the ship class brake rate. It outranks both flight-assist dampings: only one damping applies per tick.

flight_assist.description: Flight assist engaged. False is full Newtonian flight: no damping, no auto-levelling. Default is true.
